image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large iguana resting on rocks near water. The iguana has a prominent dorsal crest, a large dewlap, and textured scales. Its coloration is a mix of orange, brown, and black, suggesting it may be an adult male or in breeding coloration, rather than the typical bright green of juveniles. The background features blurred water and rocks.
